headline.funnel_interpretation: Egger’s test is generally not recommended when fewer than 10 studies are available.
headline.results_interpretation: The pooled analysis of 3 studies yielded an effect size of 1.01 (95% CI: 0.75–1.36), indicating no statistically significant association between betaine and renal cell carcinoma. Although the point estimate suggests a potential positive relationship, the confidence interval includes the null. These findings were accompanied by low heterogeneity (I² = 17.57%), indicating consistent findings across the included studies.
